title: Whiel: A Neurosymbolic Platform for Certified Relational Program Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.05612v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present the Whiel (a contraction of Whi(le-R)el) system for Lean-certified reasoning about imperative relational programs. The system can encode containment and equivalence problems for Datalog, its extensions with negation, and the core fragment of graph query languages. It can also represent optimized or incremental evaluation algorithms that are not expressible in the original query language, as well as first-order specifications of integrity constraints, schema mappings, and views arising in data integration, exchange, and sharing. Whiel's program states are database instances, and its imperative structure enables compositional Hoare-style reasoning with first-order relational specifications, using prophecy variables and leveled invariants to support inductive arguments. Whiel supports neurosymbolic discovery of loop invariants whose verification conditions can be checked using the Vampire first-order theorem prover. Counterexam

translated_title: Whiel：一个用于认证关系程序验证的神经符号平台
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 Whiel（Whi(le-R)el 的缩写）系统，用于在 Lean 中对命令式关系程序进行可认证的推理。该系统能够编码 Datalog 及其带否定的扩展、以及图查询语言核心片段的包含与等价问题。它还可以表示原始查询语言无法表达的优化或增量求值算法，以及数据集成、交换与共享中出现的完整性约束、模式映射和视图的一阶规范。Whiel 的程序状态是数据库实例，其命令式结构支持基于一阶关系规范的组合式 Hoare 风格推理，并借助预言变量和分层不变量来支持归纳论证。Whiel 支持通过神经符号方法发现循环不变量，其产生的验证条件可使用 Vampire 一阶定理证明器进行检验。反例……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: Whiel 是一个基于 Lean 认证的神经符号验证平台，它把以数据库实例为状态的命令式关系程序与 Hoare 风格推理、神经符号循环不变量发现及 Vampire 定理证明器相结合，实现了对 Datalog 等查询语言的包含/等价问题以及数据集成中完整性约束、模式映射与视图规范的可认证验证。
